# BtnWarp Template Tasks & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Bootstrap Buttons 13 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/bootstrap-buttons-13/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bb/bootstrap-buttons-13/`
- **New Name**: `btnwarp`
- **Design Category**: UI Components / Button Showcase

## Section-by-Section Plan

1. **Navbar / Header**: Dark themed title bar with template branding.
2. **Hero / Introduction**: Section title "Button Showcase #13" with subtitle.
3. **Solid Buttons Grid**: Primary (`#3e64ff`), Secondary (`#bd83ce`), Tertiary (`#8105d8`), Quarternary (`#52de97`).
4. **Outline Buttons Grid**: Translucent borders on dark background with hover fills.
5. **Rounded / Pill Buttons**: Fully rounded (`rounded-full`) variants for all color tiers.
6. **Icon Buttons**: Buttons featuring Lucide icons (heart, share, etc.) in leading and trailing positions.
7. **Social Media Buttons**: Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Dribbble buttons with follower counts and share statistics.
8. **Footer**: Copyright and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).
